SELECT t.*, u.username AS author_name, c.name AS category_name, lr.username AS last_reply_by_name FROM forum_topics t LEFT JOIN users u ON t.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN forum_categories c ON t.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN users lr ON t.last_reply_by = lr.id WHERE t.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO forum_topics (title, content, category_id, user_id, view_count, reply_count, like_count, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{categoryId}, #{userId}, 0, 0, 0, 1, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE forum_topics SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE forum_topics SET like_count = like_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
